hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if printf "%s" "$cmd" | grep -Eq "codex" && printf "%s" "$cmd" | grep -Eiq -- "--dangerously-bypass|danger-full-access"; then echo "blocked: codex sandbox/approval bypass flags are not permitted" >&2; exit 2; fi
"${TMUX_AGENT_INDICATOR_DIR:-$HOME/.tmux/plugins/tmux-agent-indicator}"/scripts/agent-state.sh --agent claude --state off
"${TMUX_AGENT_INDICATOR_DIR:-$HOME/.tmux/plugins/tmux-agent-indicator}"/scripts/agent-state.sh --agent claude --state running
[ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ] && tmux set-option -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" @pstate "" || true
"${TMUX_AGENT_INDICATOR_DIR:-$HOME/.tmux/plugins/tmux-agent-indicator}"/scripts/agent-state.sh --agent claude --state needs-input
[ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ] && tmux set-option -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" @pstate needs-input || true
"${TMUX_AGENT_INDICATOR_DIR:-$HOME/.tmux/plugins/tmux-agent-indicator}"/scripts/agent-state.sh --agent claude --state done
[ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ] && tmux set-option -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" @pstate done || true
